[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/20 (Sat) 01:44  
[FACT] User is looking for new recipe ideas, specifically for chicken and vegetable skewers.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Chicken and vegetable skewers are a great choice for a quick, healthy, and flavorful meal.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended Mediterranean skewers: Marinate chicken and vegetables like cherry tomatoes, bell peppers, onions, and mushrooms in olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, and oregano.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended Asian-Style skewers: Combine chicken, bell peppers, onions, and pineapple chunks with a sweet and sour sauce made from soy sauce, honey, and rice vinegar.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended Indian-Inspired skewers: Alternate chicken with cherry tomatoes, mushrooms, and bell peppers, and brush with a yogurt-based marinade flavored with cumin, coriander, and cayenne pepper.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended Korean BBQ skewers: Marinate chicken and vegetables like zucchini, carrots, and green onions in a spicy Korean chili flake-infused sauce (gochujang) with soy sauce, brown sugar, and garlic.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended Mexican Fiesta skewers: Combine chicken with colorful bell peppers, onions, and cherry tomatoes, and brush with a zesty lime juice and chili powder marinade.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended Japanese Teriyaki skewers: Alternate chicken with mushrooms, bell peppers, and green beans, and brush with a sweet and savory teriyaki sauce made from soy sauce, sake, and mirin.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended Veggie-Centric options: Roasted Veggie skewers with Brussels sprouts, sweet potatoes, and red onions; Mushroom and Leek skewers with creamy garlic butter sauce; Grilled Asparagus and Lemon skewers.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for skewers: Use different types of chicken (breasts, thighs, drumsticks), experiment with various vegetables (eggplant, zucchini, broccoli), add heat with red pepper flakes or jalapeños, serve with quinoa, couscous, or rice, and try different skewer materials (bamboo or metal).  
[PREFERENCE] User likes Mediterranean and Indian-Inspired options for skewers.  
[FACT] User usually prepares a big batch of rice or roasted vegetables on weekends to use throughout the week.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended sides for Mediterranean skewers: Greek salad, roasted lemon potatoes, grilled pita bread with hummus or tzatziki, steamed green beans, and tomato and cucumber salad.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended sides for Indian-Inspired skewers: Basmati rice, roasted cauliflower, naan bread, raita, and saag al
